# Cncf Amazon Elastic Container Registry Ecr Reviewer

Review Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Container Registry category. Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) is a fully-managed Docker container registry that makes it easy for developers to store, manage, and deploy Docker container images.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
